notes.summary: Complete rational affine spaces: global real-PA regularization of all continuous relative convex functions, and exact raw contact for every bounded continuous obstacle; arbitrary real reference coefficients retained.
notes.detailedSummary: A finite rational-position primal epigraph construction with the exact actual recession cone gives global convex majorants on rational geometry. Dual continuity on the compact slope polytope proves a uniform error bound. Finite-PA contact follows from flat-relation lineality; independently reconstructed legal-tree and localized genuine-domain continuity pass contact to non-PA obstacles. This is a scoped all-C_b affine theorem, not general singular closure.
notes.text:
New scoped theorem: on a complete rational affine d-plane, d>=1, with constant positive weight and actual real PA PC positive-growth gamma on rational geometry, every continuous convex f boundedly relative to gamma admits GLOBAL decreasing rational-geometry real PA approximants. Every bounded continuous obstacle consequently has a genuinely completed unrestricted envelope and raw contact integral zero. This extends the finite-PA affine sector to all continuous obstacles/endpoints; it does not prove the original general singular classification.

Here is the global domain proof. Identify the plane by a rational origin and saturated lattice basis with R^d. A continuous convex finite function has a supporting affine plane at every x: separate its closed epigraph from (x,f(x)-t) by the nearest-point normal and let t decrease to zero. The normal's limiting vertical component is positive, since a horizontal supporting normal would pair nonnegatively with every base direction and vanish. Divide by it. Hence f(x)=sup_p(p.x-f*(p)), where f*(p)=sup_x(p.x-f(x)). A convex finite PA reference is a finite max gamma=max_i(p_i.x+b_i): the affine gradient of an interior cell gives a global convex support. Put Delta=conv{p_i} and h(v)=max_i p_i.v. Gamma-h is bounded. Gamma's rational carrier supplies rational recession generators r_j, including both lineality signs, with epi h=cone{(r_j,h(r_j)),(0,1)} and Delta={p:p.r_j<=h(r_j) all j}. The recession cones cover R^d: any ray has an unbounded subsequence in one of the finitely many cells. On each such cone h is linear. These facts prove both cone identities. Positive growth gives h(v)>0 away from zero.

If ||f-gamma||<=C, then gamma*-C<=f*<=gamma*+C, and both conjugates have domain Delta. For p=sum t_i p_i, gamma(x)>=p.x+sum t_i b_i bounds gamma*(p) above; x=0 bounds it below. Separation gives infinity outside Delta. Thus f* is finite bounded, convex and lower semicontinuous on the compact polytope Delta. It is continuous including its boundary. At any p choose finite tangent-cone generators v_i and anchors p+eta v_i in Delta. Every nearby y in Delta has y-p=sum a_i v_i with a_i>=0 and sum a_i<=A||y-p||: eliminate dependent active columns, then bound inverses of the finitely many independent subsets. For small distances this is a convex representation by p and those fixed anchors. Convexity gives f*(y)<=f*(p)+A'||y-p||; lower semicontinuity gives the opposite limiting bound. This proves continuity without assuming the possibly irrational Delta is rational.

For eta>0, f*(p)=sup_{x rational}(p.x-f(x)) by continuity of f. At each p choose a rational x within eta of the supremum. Continuity of f* gives an open neighborhood where the same inequality holds. A finite subcover gives a finite rational sample set A with f*-eta<=g_A<=f* on Delta, g_A(p)=max_{x in A}(p.x-f(x)). Form the PRIMAL epigraph E_A=conv{(x,f(x)):x in A}+epi h. It is closed (compact hull plus closed cone), projects onto all R^d and lies in epi f: the support representation with p in Delta gives f(x+v)<=f(x)+h(v), so recession additions and convex combinations preserve epi f. Let its finite convex lower boundary be F_A. Maximizing on its generators shows F_A*=g_A on Delta and infinity outside it. Supporting-plane duality therefore gives f<=F_A<=f+eta GLOBALLY.

All lower epigraph faces project to convex hulls of active rational sample positions plus cones of active rational directions r_j. A lower supporting face is a graph, so projection is injective there; intersections of graph faces give intersections of projected faces. These form a finite RATIONAL carrying complex, although sampled heights and slopes may be irrational. Therefore F_A is genuine real PA PC and boundedly relative to the SAME gamma. No irrational maximum wall is asserted rational. Choose errors 2^-n and add rational constants 4*2^-n; consecutive drops are at least 2^-n-(2^-n)/2=2^(-n-1), giving global decreasing regularization. Only then does granted S272 apply its raw operator. This proves membership for all affine continuous relative convex functions, in particular all actual bounded-obstacle envelopes by R230. It asserts no literal integrality.

For a finite real PA obstacle, its envelope is genuinely finite rational-geometry PA. Pointedly refine the common rational carrier. Each obstacle epigraph piece has finitely many lifted rational base vertices, lifted rational recession generators with exact heights h(r) (a bounded PA obstacle has zero recession slope), and the vertical ray. The closed convex hull of their union is the compact hull of all lifted vertices plus the cone of all listed rays. Rays from a piece can be added to any convex-hull point by mixing vanishing coefficients at points tending to infinity along that piece's ray, which proves the closed-hull identity. It lies above the convex lower bound gamma-||u|| and below the obstacle. Its lower boundary is the greatest continuous convex minorant, hence the actual unrestricted envelope by R230, and its graph faces project rationally as above. A constant PA approximating sequence checks this endpoint's raw domain.

Finite affine contact follows directly from the raw recursion. At a noncontact vertex of a PA envelope, the granted PC strict-floor perturbation forces a nontrivial flat relation sum lambda_i d_i=0, sum lambda_i h(d_i)=0. Choose a linear support ell of this convex homogeneous full-plane germ at zero. Then b=h-ell is nonnegative and subadditive, and each active b(d_i)=0. For an active nonzero rational direction d_j, the relation expresses -d_j as a nonnegative combination of the other zero directions, so b(-d_j)=0. Subadditivity in both directions gives b(x+t d_j)=b(x) for every real t. The germ is affine along a nonzero rational line. Its linearity fan has this common lineality and no zero-dimensional faces; the d-step raw product is zero. Refinement independence preserves zero after artificial vertex cuts. Thus every positive raw PA atom is contact and the exact finite integral is zero. No Alexandrov measure was substituted.

The NON-PA passage needs local convergence, not false global C_b density. It is independently reconstructed as follows. For any finite valued F let TF(x) be the infimum of F(x) and weighted values over all printed legal PCCs centered at x. Starting at gamma+u with ||u||<=C, iterates decrease between gamma-C and gamma+C. Finite weighted sums commute with decreasing limits, and infima over iterate index and legal split commute; the limit is a fixed point of T, hence PC. Every PC minorant is below every iterate; the bounded-relative limit is itself a competitor. It is precisely the actual envelope. Each iterate is the infimum of costs on finite legal splitting trees, by choosing finitely many child trees with distributed approximation errors. No-op leaves are allowed and each node has its own rational witnessing structure. An e-optimal tree's terminal probability nu satisfies integral(gamma+c)dnu<=gamma(x)+c+2C+e. Its tail above height R is at most that quantity/R. Evaluate the SAME legal tree for v, with ||v||<=C, and reverse u,v. With H=gamma+c>=0 proper, this gives |P(u)(x)-P(v)(x)|<=sup_{H<=R}|u-v|+2C(H(x)+2C)/R. Hence bounded local-uniform obstacle convergence gives local-uniform envelope convergence on every compact set. Bellman iterates receive no measure and these probabilities are not MA probabilities.

On the EXISTING genuine completion, for a compact rational PA test psi supported in K, telescope finite mixed tuples and apply bounded primitive IBP. D_psi Z is supported in K and has variation <=L_psi=2M/(epsilon eta_psi), because granted same-reference DC auxiliaries express it as a scaled difference of two positive mixed products of mass M. Thus |<psi,MA(a)-MA(b)>|<=L_psi sum_i sup_K|a_i-b_i|. Pass through genuine global uniform approximants of any two already completed tuples. The same local estimate holds on D, so completed local-uniform limits, with an already completed limit, have vaguely convergent measures. Compact-test density and the granted all-tuple fixed-C height bound supply tightness before weak convergence. Cutoffs then give each C_b test. For contact gaps g_n bounded by 2C and locally convergent, compact cutoffs pass the integrals and the two height tails contribute at most 4CK_C/T. Thus the raw contact integrals converge. This argument does not enlarge D.

Finally approximate any bounded continuous u locally uniformly by compactly supported rational-affine PA obstacles u_n with ||u_n||<=||u||+1/n. Take compact cutoffs of u, then finite rational norm bumps approximating their positive/negative parts uniformly; continuity scales and fine rational nets control the error and supports. This is not global uniform density in C_b. The new domain proof gives completed endpoints for EVERY u_n and u. The finite epigraph proof gives finite PA envelopes for u_n, with zero contact. The reconstructed tree/local measure arguments pass those exact integrals to u. This completes all the affine non-PA/domain antecedents.

notes.text:
New structural obstruction and sector classification. In a finite globally embedded positive balanced d-space, suppose a rational point v has weighted tangent cycle C_v containing c[Q], c>0, for a full rational linear d-plane Q, with C_v-c[Q] explicitly effective and balanced. Suppose its tangent SUPPORT contains a two-sided rational line L transverse to Q (Q intersect L={0}). Then every actual real PA PC positive-growth reference has a bounded real PA obstacle with a genuine finite relative PA envelope and strictly negative raw contact integral. Support inclusion alone is not asserted to supply the positive subcycle hypothesis.

Choose a saturated lattice basis of Q. Rational linear algebra extends its dual coordinate forms to ambient rational ell_1,...,ell_d vanishing on L, since Q and L are independent. Let h=sum_j |ell_j| on the whole tangent support. It is ambient convex homogeneous rational PA PC on a finite rational hyperplane refinement. It vanishes on both primitive rational directions of L, producing a legal flat PCC at the rational vertex after refinement.

The primitive raw calibration is explicit. On a complete saturated d-plane with weight c, let A be the restriction matrix of ell_j in its saturated basis. D_|ell| of that plane is twice the positive primitive evaluation of ell times its saturated kernel cycle: opposite inward normals give the two terms. Rational scaling reduces to integral forms. The Euclidean algorithm changes a basis until an integer row is (g,0,...,0), g its positive gcd, constructing its saturated kernel basis and primitive complement. Repeating the same factor is zero because |ell| restricts to zero on its kernel. For independent distinct forms, intersect their saturated kernels successively. A basis of each kernel extends by a primitive complement to a basis of the preceding lattice; in these nested bases the matrix is triangular. The primitive positive evaluations multiply to |det A|, including every index. Each ordered distinct-factor product is 2^d|det A| delta_0. There are d! orders in expansion of D_h^d, and repeated-factor terms vanish by commutativity. Therefore raw atom=c 2^d d!|det A|. If A is singular, its rational common kernel is nonzero lineality and the raw top product is zero. The factorial arises from the mixed expansion, not from an appended operator normalization.

On Q our matrix is the identity. Cycle linearity and ambient convex supports against the effective balanced residual give m_0(h;C_v)>=c 2^d d!>0. True zero weights in the residual/intermediate cycles are allowed. Granted S272 applies to this specific rational PC jet and finite rational star refinement, producing a genuine global relative real PA F with the SAME germ C+t+delta h in every rational reference summand. Thus flatness survives and the raw atom is delta^d m_0(h)>0. Its PA roof theorem gives u=F-gamma+(R-rho(x-v))_+ on rational geometry, with actual unrestricted envelope F and exact contact integral -R delta^d m_0(h)<0. The flat boundary relation bounds competitors at v; radial chords bound rational points in the roof, shrinking rational simplices bound real points, and outside the roof the obstacle is already F. Only v has mass inside the chosen small roof. All endpoint and measure antecedents are finite PA and genuine; no all-obstacle domain assumption is used to exclude this pair.

A new all-obstacle classification follows for the exact geometric category X=union_i Q_i of finitely many DISTINCT rational affine d-planes, with cycle sum_i c_i[Q_i], c_i>0, saturated lattices and the actual gamma as above. Simultaneous regularization and raw contact for EVERY bounded continuous obstacle holds iff the Q_i are pairwise disjoint. If two intersect, their rational equations have a rational solution v. Choose rational a in the second tangent d-plane but outside the first; L=R a is two-sided in the tangent support and transverse to the first. The tangent cycle at v is the sum of the planes containing v, so the first plane has an effective balanced residual. The preceding theorem yields an actual finite-PA negative-contact witness for every actual gamma.

If they are pairwise disjoint, a finite family of affine subspaces has positive mutual distances: their differences are closed affine subspaces avoiding zero. Each Q_i is an open/closed component, every connected polyhedral cell lies in a component, and every PCC incidence is confined there. The unrestricted envelope is componentwise. The all-continuous affine theorem n2 applies to the reference on each component. Finitely many decreasing global approximations synchronize on common rational refinements, checking genuine global regularization; raw locality and cycle addition sum their measures. Every component integral is zero, hence the global integral is zero. At an intersecting arrangement point the obstruction's exact atom is 2^d d! sum_{i:v in Q_i} c_i |det A_i|, singular matrices contributing zero and at least one identity contribution positive.

This is an all-C_b classification of AFFINE ARRANGEMENTS and a more general necessary obstruction, not the entire original P05.2. General singular/glued spaces, domain membership there, non-PA sufficiency and complete structural reduction of all rational refinements remain OPEN. Literal integral-slope/rational-constant references remain subject to the separate granted noncompact regularity obstruction and acquire no literal measure at excluded endpoints. No abstract compact-chart conclusion is inferred from an embedded proof. Files: P05.2-paper.tex, argument.md, scope-and-gaps.md, source-application-ledger.md. Candidate=false.
